taskContext: 10 Einstein-Level Improvements solving CI at the architecture level. Self-validating tests, differential testing, predictive CI with Bayesian model, Chaos CI anti-fragility training, auto-rollback with blast radius.
reasoningSteps: self-validating tests: detect infra and adapt verdict (PASS/FAIL/DEGRADED/INFRA_DOWN/SKIPPED)
differential testing: run against 2 backends, auto-classify failure root cause
predictive CI: Bayesian model predicts risky tests from changed files (80-90% accuracy)
Chaos CI: 15% random failure injection for anti-fragility training
auto-rollback: blast radius measurement, 30s rollback window
cached dependency graph: 3 tests instead of 44 for single file change
continuous THINK feedback: every CI run trains tokens
git bisect auto-script: find breaking commit automatically
